text: The measured cohort contains real artifacts and deterministic verdicts, but contains no validation pool, stake, deliberation round, or reputation weight from the proposed mechanism.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reinforcement Learning from Reputation Feedback (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7456999
abstract: Nothing in this cohort is modeled. The parties are real systems, the artifacts are real outputs, and the verdicts come from a checker rather than a parameter. What the cohort does not contain is the mechanism: no validation pool, no stake, no deliberation round, and no reputation weight in the sense of equation (1).

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: the evidentiary reach of the measured cohort
